verdict: Organic is strong, but overdue heating-season campaigns are costing you leads.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 34 leads at an average cost of $43.86 per lead, with all tracked leads coming through Meta — Google Ads is running but not yet recording conversions. Lead volume dipped roughly 39% week-over-week as ad spend pulled back, pushing cost per lead up nearly 20%; that cost increase is structural, not seasonal, and is being addressed directly. On the organic side, your Google Business Profiles generated 144 actions this period — including 98 direction requests and 21 calls — up 33% from the prior week, which shows your local presence is working. The core issue is that several planned heating-season campaigns and account setups that were due between August and October are not yet live, and getting those launched is the immediate priority. Once those are active, paid lead volume and cost efficiency are both expected to improve heading into peak heating season.
